## Professional Summary

Web and SaaS developer building websites, SaaS products and MVPs with AI in the loop — full-stack,
design through deployment. Nine years of production software: roughly four years hands-on
engineering (Java/JEE, Spring, Node.js, TypeScript, Angular, iOS) and five leading delivery for
distributed enterprise teams across telecom, automotive, life sciences and retail.

The differentiator is the pairing: AI in the build loop is what compresses timelines from months to
weeks, while nine years inside enterprise codebases and delivery programmes is what keeps the
architecture, tests and data model sound enough to survive real users. Certified in Scrum and SAFe.

## Services

- **Websites that rank and convert** — marketing sites, landing pages and portfolios designed and
  built from scratch, not templated. Ships with the SEO foundation most sites bolt on too late:
  structured data, clean semantics, real meta, sitemap, and Core Web Vitals as a requirement.
- **SaaS & MVP builds** — the smallest version that proves the idea: auth, data model, core flows,
  payments if needed, deployed on infrastructure that won't need replacing when it works.
- **Architecture & technical rescue** — for products that shipped fast and now can't move. Codebase
  audit, a plainly-stated view of what's worth saving, a sequenced refactor plan, or the work itself.
- **AI-augmented automation** — LLM workflows, agents, retrieval over internal documents, and
  integrations between systems that don't talk, measured against the pre-automation baseline.

## How Engagements Run

1. **Scope** (free, ~1 week) — a call, then a written scope: what gets built, what doesn't, cost, and
   the date it lands. Includes an honest "I'm not the right fit" if that's the answer.
2. **Build** (2 to 6 weeks typical) — a working link from week one, weekly demo, direct access, and an
   architecture review at the end of each week.
3. **Ship** (days) — live on the client's own infrastructure, domain and accounts, with performance,
   accessibility and SEO verified before launch.
4. **Hand over** (included) — repo, pipeline, documentation and a walkthrough. The client can take it
   to any developer afterwards.

Fixed scope. Fixed price. A date in writing. Code ownership transfers to the client from day one.
